Privacy Policy.

How we handle the data of people who visit the site, make a request, or subscribe to our list — under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD).

Last updated: November 2026.

What data we collectWhat we use it forNewsletter sign-upBrowser preference storageWho we share data withYour rightsContact

What data we collect

Name, WhatsApp number and, when applicable, email — only when you provide them yourself, when requesting a booking, a quote, or subscribing to our newsletter. We do not collect browsing data, location, or data from other sites.

What we use it for

To reply to your request (booking, quote, question) and, only with your separate and explicit consent, to send news and offers from Good Vibes Va'a by email.

Newsletter sign-up

We store the email you provide, the site language at the time of sign-up, and the exact consent text you accepted — this serves as proof of your authorization, as required by the LGPD. Each email is registered only once.

Browser preference storage

We use browser-local storage (sessionStorage/localStorage) only to remember that you've already closed a pop-up or completed a sign-up, so we don't show it again. This stays on your device only — it isn't sent to us or to third parties.

Who we share data with

Your data is never sold or shared publicly. When online payment is active, the booking amount is processed by Mercado Pago, which only receives what's needed to charge it. Data storage is handled in a database (Supabase) with access restricted to the club's team.

Your rights

You can ask at any time to access, correct or delete your data, and unsubscribe from newsletter emails whenever you want. Just message the team on WhatsApp.

Contact

Questions about this policy or your data: message the team on WhatsApp at +55 71 99978-9710.

This text is a plain-language summary of the club's practices. We recommend legal review before any broader commercial use of the data collected.
